sections.title: Unit 5 Exercise — questions 5.23 to 5.31

paras.urdu: 5.23 پانچ عناصر والی آبادی 4، 5، 7، 9، 10 دی گئی ہے۔
(i) آبادی کا اوسط اور تغیر معلوم کریں۔
paras.pashto: (i) د نفوس منځنی او واریانس محاسبه کړئ.

paras.text: (ii) Suppose samples of size n = 3 are selected without replacement but you compute $\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2$ directly.
paras.urdu: (ii) فرض کریں n = 3 سائز کے نمونے بغیر واپسی کے منتخب کیے جاتے ہیں لیکن آپ $\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2$ براہِ راست معلوم کرتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: (ii) فرض کړئ د n = 3 اندازې نمونې پرته له بېرته اچولو ټاکل کېږي خو تاسو $\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2$ مستقیم محاسبه کوئ.

paras.text: (iii) Suppose samples of size n = 3 are selected with replacement but you compute $\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2$ directly.
paras.urdu: (iii) فرض کریں n = 3 سائز کے نمونے واپسی کے ساتھ منتخب کیے جاتے ہیں لیکن آپ $\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2$ براہِ راست معلوم کرتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: (iii) فرض کړئ د n = 3 اندازې نمونې له بېرته اچولو سره ټاکل کېږي خو تاسو $\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2$ مستقیم محاسبه کوئ.

paras.text: 5.24 Draw all possible samples of size n = 3 without replacement from the population 0, 3, 6, 12, 15, 18. Construct the sampling distribution of the sample mean and verify the relation between: (i) Mean of the sampling distribution and the population mean. (ii) Standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean and the population standard deviation.
paras.urdu: 5.24 آبادی 0، 3، 6، 12، 15، 18 سے بغیر واپسی کے n = 3 سائز کے تمام ممکنہ نمونے نکالیں۔ نمونے کے اوسط کی نمونہ جاتی تقسیم بنائیں اور ان کے درمیان تعلق کی تصدیق کریں: (i) نمونہ جاتی تقسیم کا اوسط اور آبادی کا اوسط۔ (ii) اوسط کی نمونہ جاتی تقسیم کا معیاری انحراف اور آبادی کا معیاری انحراف۔
paras.pashto: 5.24 له 0، 3، 6، 12، 15، 18 نفوس څخه پرته له بېرته اچولو د n = 3 اندازې ټولې شونې نمونې راوباسئ. د نمونې د منځني نمونوي وېش جوړ کړئ او د دې ترمنځ اړیکه تایید کړئ: (i) د نمونوي وېش منځنی او د نفوس منځنی. (ii) د منځني د نمونوي وېش معیاري انحراف او د نفوس معیاري انحراف.

paras.text: 5.25 Define sampling distribution of difference between means of two samples. Describe its important properties.
paras.urdu: 5.25 دو نمونوں کے اوسطوں کے فرق کی نمونہ جاتی تقسیم کی تعریف کریں۔ اس کی اہم خصوصیات بیان کریں۔
paras.pashto: 5.25 د دوو نمونو د منځنیو د توپیر نمونوي وېش تعریف کړئ. مهمې ځانګړنې یې بیان کړئ.

paras.text: 5.26 Draw all possible random samples of size $n_1=2$ with replacement from the finite population consisting of −2, 0, 2/and 4. Similarly draw all possible random samples of size $n_2=2$ with replacement from the population −1 and +1.
paras.urdu: 5.26 محدود آبادی −2، 0، 2/اور 4 سے واپسی کے ساتھ $n_1=2$ سائز کے تمام ممکنہ تصادفی نمونے نکالیں۔ اسی طرح آبادی −1 اور +1 سے واپسی کے ساتھ $n_2=2$ سائز کے تمام ممکنہ تصادفی نمونے نکالیں۔
paras.pashto: 5.26 له −2، 0، 2/او 4 محدود نفوس څخه له بېرته اچولو سره د $n_1=2$ اندازې ټولې شونې تصادفي نمونې راوباسئ. همداراز له −1 او +1 نفوس څخه له بېرته اچولو سره د $n_2=2$ اندازې ټولې شونې تصادفي نمونې راوباسئ.

paras.text: (i) Find the possible differences between the sample means of the two populations.

paras.text: 5.27 Draw all possible random samples of size $n_1=2$ without replacement from a finite population consisting of 3, 6, 9. Similarly draw all possible random samples of size $n_2=2$ without replacement from another finite population consisting of 2, 4, 6.
paras.urdu: 5.27 محدود آبادی 3، 6، 9 سے بغیر واپسی کے $n_1=2$ سائز کے تمام ممکنہ تصادفی نمونے نکالیں۔ اسی طرح ایک اور محدود آبادی 2، 4، 6 سے بغیر واپسی کے $n_2=2$ سائز کے تمام ممکنہ تصادفی نمونے نکالیں۔
paras.pashto: 5.27 له 3، 6، 9 محدود نفوس څخه پرته له بېرته اچولو د $n_1=2$ اندازې ټولې شونې تصادفي نمونې راوباسئ. همداراز له بل محدود نفوس 2، 4، 6 څخه پرته له بېرته اچولو د $n_2=2$ اندازې ټولې شونې تصادفي نمونې راوباسئ.

paras.text: 5.28 What is meant by proportion and sampling distribution of sample proportion $\hat{p}$? Describe its important properties.
paras.urdu: 5.28 تناسب اور نمونے کے تناسب $\hat{p}$ کی نمونہ جاتی تقسیم سے کیا مراد ہے؟ اس کی اہم خصوصیات بیان کریں۔
paras.pashto: 5.28 له تناسب او د نمونې د تناسب $\hat{p}$ له نمونوي وېش څخه مطلب څه دی؟ مهمې ځانګړنې یې بیان کړئ.

paras.text: 5.29 Draw all possible samples of size n = 3 without replacement from the population 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6 and find the sample proportion $\hat{p}$ of odd numbers in the samples. Construct the sampling distribution of sample proportion and verify that $\mu_{\hat{p}}=p$ and $Var(\hat{p})=\frac{pq}{n}\left[\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right]$
paras.urdu: 5.29 آبادی 2، 3، 3، 4، 5، 6 سے بغیر واپسی کے n = 3 سائز کے تمام ممکنہ نمونے نکالیں اور نمونوں میں طاق اعداد کا نمونہ جاتی تناسب $\hat{p}$ معلوم کریں۔ نمونے کے تناسب کی نمونہ جاتی تقسیم بنائیں اور تصدیق کریں کہ $\mu_{\hat{p}}=p$ اور $Var(\hat{p})=\frac{pq}{n}\left[\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right]$
paras.pashto: 5.29 له 2، 3، 3، 4، 5، 6 نفوس څخه پرته له بېرته اچولو د n = 3 اندازې ټولې شونې نمونې راوباسئ او په نمونو کې د طاق عددونو نمونوي تناسب $\hat{p}$ پیدا کړئ. د نمونې د تناسب نمونوي وېش جوړ کړئ او تایید کړئ چې $\mu_{\hat{p}}=p$ او $Var(\hat{p})=\frac{pq}{n}\left[\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right]$

paras.text: 5.30 The marital status of a population of seven friends is U, M, M, U, M, U, U where U and M stand for unmarried and married respectively. Find the proportion of married friends in the population. Take all possible samples of two friends without replacement from this population and find the proportion of married friends in each sample. Make the sampling distribution of the sample proportion and verify that $\mu_{\hat{p}}=p$ and $\sigma_{\hat{p}}^2=\frac{pq}{n}\left(\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right)$.
paras.urdu: 5.30 سات دوستوں کی آبادی کی ازدواجی حیثیت U، M، M، U، M، U، U ہے جہاں U اور M بالترتیب غیر شادی شدہ اور شادی شدہ کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔ آبادی میں شادی شدہ دوستوں کا تناسب معلوم کریں۔ اس آبادی سے بغیر واپسی کے دو دوستوں کے تمام ممکنہ نمونے لیں اور ہر نمونے میں شادی شدہ دوستوں کا تناسب معلوم کریں۔ نمونے کے تناسب کی نمونہ جاتی تقسیم بنائیں اور تصدیق کریں کہ $\mu_{\hat{p}}=p$ اور $\sigma_{\hat{p}}^2=\frac{pq}{n}\left(\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right)$۔
paras.pashto: 5.30 د اوو ملګرو د نفوس مدني حالت U، M، M، U، M، U، U دی چې U او M په ترتیب سره نامجرد او واده شوي ښيي. په نفوس کې د واده شویو ملګرو تناسب پیدا کړئ. له دې نفوس څخه پرته له بېرته اچولو د دوو ملګرو ټولې شونې نمونې واخلئ او په هره نمونه کې د واده شویو ملګرو تناسب پیدا کړئ. د نمونې د تناسب نمونوي وېش جوړ کړئ او تایید کړئ چې $\mu_{\hat{p}}=p$ او $\sigma_{\hat{p}}^2=\frac{pq}{n}\left(\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right)$.

sections.theory:
5.23 Given the five-element population 4, 5, 7, 9, 10.

(i) Compute population mean and variance.

(ii) Suppose samples of size n = 3 are selected without replacement but you compute \sigma_{\overline{x}}^2 directly.

(iii) Suppose samples of size n = 3 are selected with replacement but you compute \sigma_{\overline{x}}^2 directly.

5.24 Draw all possible samples of size n = 3 without replacement from the population 0, 3, 6, 12, 15, 18. Construct the sampling distribution of the sample mean and verify the relation between: (i) Mean of the sampling distribution and the population mean. (ii) Standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean and the population standard deviation.

5.25 Define sampling distribution of difference between means of two samples. Describe its important properties.

5.26 Draw all possible random samples of size n_1=2 with replacement from the finite population consisting of −2, 0, 2/and 4. Similarly draw all possible random samples of size n_2=2 with replacement from the population −1 and +1.

(i) Find the possible differences between the sample means of the two populations.

(ii) Construct the sampling distribution of \overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2.

(iii) Verify that \mu_{\overline{x}_1-\overline{x}_2}=\mu_1-\mu_2 and \sigma_{\overline{x}_1-\overline{x}_2}=\sqrt{\frac{\sigma_1^2}{n_1}+\frac{\sigma_2^2}{n_2}}

5.27 Draw all possible random samples of size n_1=2 without replacement from a finite population consisting of 3, 6, 9. Similarly draw all possible random samples of size n_2=2 without replacement from another finite population consisting of 2, 4, 6.

(i) Find the possible differences between the sample means of the two populations.

(ii) Construct the sampling distribution of \overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2 and compute its mean and variance. Also verify the theoretical results.

5.28 What is meant by proportion and sampling distribution of sample proportion \hat{p}? Describe its important properties.

5.29 Draw all possible samples of size n = 3 without replacement from the population 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6 and find the sample proportion \hat{p} of odd numbers in the samples. Construct the sampling distribution of sample proportion and verify that \mu_{\hat{p}}=p and Var(\hat{p})=\frac{pq}{n}\left[\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right]

5.30 The marital status of a population of seven friends is U, M, M, U, M, U, U where U and M stand for unmarried and married respectively. Find the proportion of married friends in the population. Take all possible samples of two friends without replacement from this population and find the proportion of married friends in each sample. Make the sampling distribution of the sample proportion and verify that \mu_{\hat{p}}=p and \sigma_{\hat{p}}^2=\frac{pq}{n}\left(\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right).

5.31 Let \hat{p}_1 represent the proportion of even numbers in a random sample of size n_1=2 without replacement from a finite population consisting of values 4, 6, 9. Similarly, let \hat{p}_2 represent the proportion of even numbers in a random sample of size n_2=2 without replacement from another finite population consisting of values 2, 2, 5. Form a sampling distribution of \hat{p}_1-\hat{p}_2 and verify that:

(i)\ E(\hat{p}_1-\hat{p}_2)=p_1-p_2

(ii)\ Var(\hat{p}_1-\hat{p}_2)=\frac{p_1q_1}{n_1}\frac{N_1-n_1}{N_1-1}+\frac{p_2q_2}{n_2}\frac{N_2-n_2}{N_2-1}

sections.content:
5.23 Given the five-element population 4, 5, 7, 9, 10.

(i) Compute population mean and variance.

(ii) Suppose samples of size n = 3 are selected without replacement but you compute \sigma_{\overline{x}}^2 directly.

(iii) Suppose samples of size n = 3 are selected with replacement but you compute \sigma_{\overline{x}}^2 directly.

5.24 Draw all possible samples of size n = 3 without replacement from the population 0, 3, 6, 12, 15, 18. Construct the sampling distribution of the sample mean and verify the relation between: (i) Mean of the sampling distribution and the population mean. (ii) Standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean and the population standard deviation.

5.25 Define sampling distribution of difference between means of two samples. Describe its important properties.

5.26 Draw all possible random samples of size n_1=2 with replacement from the finite population consisting of −2, 0, 2/and 4. Similarly draw all possible random samples of size n_2=2 with replacement from the population −1 and +1.

(i) Find the possible differences between the sample means of the two populations.

(ii) Construct the sampling distribution of \overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2.

(iii) Verify that \mu_{\overline{x}_1-\overline{x}_2}=\mu_1-\mu_2 and \sigma_{\overline{x}_1-\overline{x}_2}=\sqrt{\frac{\sigma_1^2}{n_1}+\frac{\sigma_2^2}{n_2}}

5.27 Draw all possible random samples of size n_1=2 without replacement from a finite population consisting of 3, 6, 9. Similarly draw all possible random samples of size n_2=2 without replacement from another finite population consisting of 2, 4, 6.

(i) Find the possible differences between the sample means of the two populations.

(ii) Construct the sampling distribution of \overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2 and compute its mean and variance. Also verify the theoretical results.

5.28 What is meant by proportion and sampling distribution of sample proportion \hat{p}? Describe its important properties.

5.29 Draw all possible samples of size n = 3 without replacement from the population 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6 and find the sample proportion \hat{p} of odd numbers in the samples. Construct the sampling distribution of sample proportion and verify that \mu_{\hat{p}}=p and Var(\hat{p})=\frac{pq}{n}\left[\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right]

5.30 The marital status of a population of seven friends is U, M, M, U, M, U, U where U and M stand for unmarried and married respectively. Find the proportion of married friends in the population. Take all possible samples of two friends without replacement from this population and find the proportion of married friends in each sample. Make the sampling distribution of the sample proportion and verify that \mu_{\hat{p}}=p and \sigma_{\hat{p}}^2=\frac{pq}{n}\left(\frac{N-n}{N-1}\right).

5.31 Let \hat{p}_1 represent the proportion of even numbers in a random sample of size n_1=2 without replacement from a finite population consisting of values 4, 6, 9. Similarly, let \hat{p}_2 represent the proportion of even numbers in a random sample of size n_2=2 without replacement from another finite population consisting of values 2, 2, 5. Form a sampling distribution of \hat{p}_1-\hat{p}_2 and verify that:

(i)\ E(\hat{p}_1-\hat{p}_2)=p_1-p_2

(ii)\ Var(\hat{p}_1-\hat{p}_2)=\frac{p_1q_1}{n_1}\frac{N_1-n_1}{N_1-1}+\frac{p_2q_2}{n_2}\frac{N_2-n_2}{N_2-1}
